BiblicalUsage: To thresh, to tread out the grain — adash appears once: "Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen." The farmer threshes to feed, not to destroy, and he knows when to stop.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse about threshing is a farmer's picture, and the comfort in it is God's limit — He bruises the corn to make bread, not to make dust.
